- Bulk density of cooked chunky vegetable pieces ≈ 0.6 g/ml (cubes with air gaps). Mass ≈ 110 x 0.6 ≈ 66 g. Round to about 70 g to account for the denser browned pieces.

Summary: one roasted sweet potato portion of about 70 g on a 24 cm square plate.
